name: Collateral Parameters 11
definition: Parameters which explicitly state the conditions that must be fulfilled before a particular triparty collateral instruction/transaction  can be confirmed. These parameters are defined by the instructing party in compliance with triparty collateral rules in the market the instruction/transaction will take place.

CollateralInstructionType.name: Collateral Instruction Type
CollateralInstructionType.definition: Specifies the type of collateral instruction.

ExposureType.name: Exposure Type
ExposureType.definition: Specifies the underlying business area/type of trade causing the exposure.

CollateralSide.name: Collateral Side
CollateralSide.definition: Specifies whether the alleged side is the collateral taker or giver. So it will be the opposite  side of the instruction.

ValueSoughtMarginRate.name: Value Sought Margin Rate
ValueSoughtMarginRate.definition: Percentage by which the collateral value sought is increased, in selecting securities for a collateral basket, to reflect the taker's margin requirements.

EligibilitySetProfile.name: Eligibility Set Profile
EligibilitySetProfile.definition: Number identifying the collateral eligibility set profile of the counterparty.

TransferTitle.name: Transfer Title
TransferTitle.definition: Change of title for the collateral. If N then collateral is pledged.

SettlementProcess.name: Settlement Process
SettlementProcess.definition: Specifies the settlement process in which the collateral will be settled.
